# ==== CHI-PAID: what the Qing pays per good + its penetration (regional divergence AS FELT) ====
ECON_LOG_tzprobe_chipaid = {
	# Scope: country (CHI, guarded by caller). country_unit_price_<good> = world gbip / (0.5 + penetration);
	# penetration is the per-country, per-TZ, shipping-driven access term (capped 1, x0.4545). Together these
	# show whether the Qing pays LESS for China-sourced goods than the world price implies (#46/#50).
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP CHIPAID silver"
		# silver CHI paidprice
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = country_unit_price_silver } }  debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice UNSET" }
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tzp_v  value = var:country_unit_price_silver }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v > -999999999 } }  debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice EMPTY" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v <= 0 }       debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 0" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 0.01 }     debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 0-0.01" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 0.1 }      debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 0.01-0.1" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 1 }        debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 0.1-1" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 10 }       debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 1-10" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 100 }      debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 10-100" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 1000 }     debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 100-1000" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 10000 }    debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 1000-10000" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 100000 }   debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice 10000-100000" }
			else = { debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI paidprice >=100000" }
			remove_variable = ECON_LOG_tzp_v
		}
		# silver CHI penetration
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = country_global_market_penetration_silver } }  debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration UNSET" }
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tzp_v  value = var:country_global_market_penetration_silver }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v > -999999999 } }  debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration EMPTY" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v <= 0 }       debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 0" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 0.01 }     debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 0-0.01" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 0.1 }      debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 0.01-0.1" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 1 }        debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 0.1-1" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 10 }       debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 1-10" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 100 }      debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 10-100" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 1000 }     debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 100-1000" }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ECON_LOG_tzp_v < 10000 }    debug_log = "IMP19C TZP BAND silver CHI penetration 1000-10000" }

# ==== EXACT TICKS: metal price inputs that feed gbip (bounded; shared tail caps at 8000) ====
ECON_LOG_tzprobe_exact = {
	# Scope: country (CHI). Exact scaled-integer tick-counts for the metal PRICE inputs to gbip.
	# SCALE chosen so realistic values land well under the shared tail's 8000 cap. Read: count
	# "IMP19C TZP unit" after a "TZP LABEL ..." and before the next LABEL, / SCALE.
	# NOTE [review HIGH-2]: world-scale SUM vars (global_stockpile_*, per-zone stock/order) are NOT
	# exact-ticked — they would peg the 8000 cap every dump (multi-GB log, truncated=useless). Their
	# magnitude is captured by the BANDS. Only gbip (post-sqrt, small) + per-zone local_price are ticked.
	# [#51] BOTH metals ticked (was silver-only): the gold/silver gbip pair is the #46 sell-reserve
	# comparison — exact values needed to see whether/how far silver crosses gold.
	debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver GLOBAL gbip"
	if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_base_import_price_silver }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_base_import_price_silver } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 2000 }
	ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
	# --- per-zone silver price (the local_price = order/stockpile x0.6 input to gbip) ---
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver india price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_india_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_india_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
		ECON_LOG_curx_tick_emit = yes
		debug_log = "IMP19C TZP LABEL silver east_north_america price"
		if = { limit = { exists = global_var:global_east_north_america_tradezone }  set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = global_var:global_east_north_america_tradezone.var:local_price_silver } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickval  value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ECON_LOG_tickscale  value = 100 }
